title: data for billing.charges_pending
description: Charges (e.g. new inbound messages) could not be debited for lack of balance and were left pending; messages keep being received and delivered. Sent once per episode; pending charges are settled automatically on the next top-up. Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

pending_micros.description: Total pending. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

available_micros.description: Available at the time. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").
